    stor_id  TEXT     not null,
    ord_num  TEXT  not null,
    ord_date DATETIME    not null,
    qty      INTEGER     not null,
    payterms TEXT  not null,
    title_id TEXT   not null,
    primary key (stor_id, ord_num, title_id),
